about: The copy rules (ADR-0005, ADR-0011): an empty selection, then a misaligned one, then one past the cap is refused; otherwise the plan names the rectangles and how they combine. From tests/ExGrid.Tests/CopyRuleTests.cs.

cases.name: ADR-0005: a single range under the cap copies, one segment, canonically vertical
ADR-0005: past the cap it does not copy at all: Ctrl+A over a million rows is refused as too large
ADR-0005: refusal is strictly past the cap: a whole column of a million cells copies
ADR-0005: refusal is strictly past the cap: two whole columns are one cell too many many times over
ADR-0005: the cap is the Consumer's to raise or lower
ADR-0005: a cap below one cell is a misconfiguration, not a refusal
ADR-0011: ranges sharing a column span with disjoint row spans stack vertically, and the gap closes up
ADR-0011: the transpose: a shared row span with disjoint column spans sits side by side
ADR-0011: ranges lining up on neither axis are refused, and the reason says so
ADR-0011: overlapping row spans would emit the same cells twice, and are refused as misaligned
ADR-0011: segments come back in position order, not the order they were made in
ADR-0005: nothing selected, nothing copied, with its own reason
ADR-0005: a misaligned selection over the cap reports the misalignment: the cap has no well-formed block to judge
ADR-0005 / CP-18: the header row counts against the cap: a selection exactly on it copies plainly and refuses with headers
ADR-0005 / CP-18: with room for the extra row it copies with headers, as the plain copy does
